name: Watchers
description: Dark Gift Feat (Prerequisite: Ravenloft Campaign) Something unnatural is always watching you, taking the form of scurrying vermin and other eerie creatures. You gain the following features. In addition, immediately after you make a D20 Test and roll a 1 on the d20, paranoia threatens to overwhelm you. Make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 13 plus your Proficiency Bonus). On a failed save, you have Disadvantage on D20 Tests for 1 minute. You can repeat the save at the end of each of your turns, ending the effect early on a success.

features.name: Borrowed Eyes
features.description: You always have the Beast Sense and Speak with Animals spells prepared. You can cast each spell without a spell slot, and you must finish a Long Rest before you can cast it in this way again. You can also cast these spells using spell slots you have of the appropriate level.

features.name: Heightened Suspicion
features.description: Whenever you take the Search action, you can roll 1d4 and add the number rolled to any ability check made as part of that action.

features.name: Incessant Watchers
features.description: You have Disadvantage on saving throws made against the Scrying spell.
